# Hi there! 👋

Thanks for asking about our **Plant Club Collector plan!**

The **Collector plan costs $49/month**. You'll get a surprise medium or rare plant in a 6-inch pot delivered in the first full week of each month.

You're charged on the **25th** of the previous month, so you have plenty of time to manage your subscription if you need to skip, pause, or make changes.

Is there anything else you'd like to know about Plant Club or our other membership options? 🌱
